selectedTask.title: FREE-LOCAL-PHONE-ACCEPTANCE
selectedTask.text: FREE-LOCAL-PHONE-ACCEPTANCE — Desktop LAN runtime proof is refreshed with publish-safe placeholders: `npm run phone:lan:start` printed `http://<LAN-IP>:3100` and `http://<LAN-IP>:3100/hq?focus=hq-chronicle`, while the sanitized desktop route harness returned 200 for `/api/health`, `/hq?focus=hq-chronicle`, and `/command`; raw `/api/free-local-readiness` returned `401 AUTH-PROTECTED` without a browser session as expected. The Free Local Readiness panel now has a single **Copy acceptance steps** brief for phone URL, direct HQ URL, `ping`, the local AI proof prompt, PWA install, and placeholder-only evidence. `npm run phone:acceptance:capture` writes sanitized `docs/metrics/phone-local-acceptance-*.json` artifacts; latest blocked artifact `docs/metrics/phone-local-acceptance-2026-05-09T22-28-55-871Z.json` records `acceptanceReady: false` because the runtime was not listening during capture and no manual phone flags were supplied. Remaining manual acceptance from the phone: open one LAN URL, log in with `NEXUS_TOKEN`, send `ping`, ask one local Ollama prompt, install the PWA, then rerun capture with all manual flags.
